protocol.threshold_selection: walk-forward: F1-optimal on pooled out-of-time predictions of PRIOR months only
protocol.champion_selection: walk-forward parsimony rule on prior months' PR-AUC: candidates within 1 fold-std of the best are tied; fixed tie-break order lightgbm > xgboost > catboost > hist_gb > random_forest > logistic_regression > ensemble (hardware independent)
protocol.feature_constants: fit on each fold's training rows only (fit_domain_params)
protocol.final_models: refit on all 2025 rows after selection; threshold = pooled out-of-time F1 optimum
protocol.regime_definitions_caveat: Regime rules originate from full-year EDA (design-time hypothesis); only numeric constants are fit train-only.
protocol.bootstrap_note: Bootstrap CI resamples rows i.i.d. and ignores temporal correlation; treat as optimistic.

seasonality.limitation: Only one year (2025) is available: December and a generic 'holiday effect' are not separable and no month other than December shows a distinct seasonal regime. Calendar features can express the December uplift but cannot be validated out-of-time for any other season.

sanity.note: Jan/2026 has no labels; expected volume assumes the model is calibrated out-of-time (see monthly_calibration_champion).
